captions.detailed: A minimalist, clamp-on task lamp designed for a desk edge. It features a C-clamp base, a lower vertical arm segment, an upper vertical arm segment, and a cylindrical lamp shade. The entire assembly is rendered in a uniform matte light gray. The lower arm rotates at a hinge just above the clamp, the upper arm connects via a middle hinge, and the cylindrical shade tilts on a hinge at the top of the upper arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a clamp-on task lamp with a C-clamp base, two articulating vertical arm segments, and a cylindrical lamp shade. The joints should be modeled as revolute connections to allow for realistic hinge articulation.
captions.factory: Construct the model using multiple parts joined by revolute articulations. Build the base as a C-clamp shape using a combination of box primitives and a threaded clamp screw. Create the lower and upper arms using thin rectangular extrusions with cylindrical hinge bosses at their ends. Model the lamp shade as a hollow cylinder. Define three revolute joints: one connecting the base to the lower arm, one at the elbow connecting the lower and upper arms, and one at the top connecting the upper arm to the lamp shade.
